paragraphs.en: Homebrew's official macOS GUI: making package management approachable for users who prefer graphical interfaces over Terminal, while maintaining complete transparency about underlying Homebrew operations.
paragraphs.zh: Homebrew 的官方 macOS 图形界面：让喜欢图形界面而非终端的用户也能轻松管理软件包，同时对其底层 Homebrew 操作保持完全透明。

paragraphs.en: Enable CLI-averse users to safely discover, install, update and manage Homebrew packages through a native SwiftUI interface that never hides what Homebrew is doing.
paragraphs.zh: 让不熟悉命令行的用户能够通过原生的 SwiftUI 界面安全地发现、安装、更新和管理 Homebrew 软件包，且该界面从不隐藏 Homebrew 的操作过程。

paragraphs.en: brew install --cask homebrew-app Homebrew configuration Put Homebrew options in brew.env and relaunch BrewUI after changing them. Shell aliases and exported variables do not configure the app. See Homebrew configuration .
paragraphs.zh: brew install --cask homebrew-app Homebrew 配置 将 Homebrew 选项放入 brew.env 中，更改后重新启动 BrewUI。 Shell 别名和导出的变量不会配置该应用。 参见 Homebrew 配置。

sents.en: brew install --cask homebrew-app Homebrew configuration Put Homebrew options in brew.env and relaunch BrewUI after changing them.
sents.zh: brew install --cask homebrew-app Homebrew 配置 将 Homebrew 选项放入 brew.env 中，更改后重新启动 BrewUI。

sents.en: Shell aliases and exported variables do not configure the app.
sents.zh: Shell 别名和导出的变量不会配置该应用。

paragraphs.en: ./scripts/bootstrap This installs Mint from Brewfile , runs mint bootstrap to build the SwiftFormat and SwiftLint versions pinned in Mintfile , enables repository git hooks and resolves Swift package dependencies for Homebrew.xcodeproj .
paragraphs.zh: ./scripts/bootstrap 该脚本通过 Brewfile 安装 Mint，运行 mint bootstrap 来构建 Mintfile 中固定版本的 SwiftFormat 和 SwiftLint，启用仓库的 git 钩子，并为 Homebrew.xcodeproj 解析 Swift 包依赖。

paragraphs.en: After bootstrap, commits automatically run checks on staged Swift files:
paragraphs.zh: 引导完成（bootstrap）后，提交时会自动对已暂存的 Swift 文件运行检查：

paragraphs.en: The hook also runs BrewUILint over the production tree. If unresolved lint violations remain, the commit is blocked and the hook prints the failures so you can fix and re-commit.
paragraphs.zh: 该钩子还会对生产构建产物运行 BrewUILint。 如果仍存在未解决的 lint 违规，提交将被阻止，并且该钩子会打印出失败信息，以便你修复后重新提交。

paragraphs.en: See development setup for signing configuration, conventions and testing for contributor guidance and architecture for system design.
paragraphs.zh: 签名配置请参阅开发环境搭建，贡献者指南请参阅约定与测试，系统设计请参阅架构说明。

paragraphs.en: Translations are community-sourced and a partial one is welcome: any string without a translation falls back to English. Copy lives in one Localizable.xcstrings catalog per UI target, Homebrew/ for the window, sidebar and menus, and Resources/ in BrewUIComponents and each BrewFeature* package. Edit a catalog in Xcode. See localisation for the reasoning behind the steps below.
paragraphs.zh: 翻译由社区提供，部分翻译也受欢迎：任何没有翻译的字符串都会回退到英文。 文案存储在每个 UI target 各自的一个 Localizable.xcstrings 目录中，Homebrew/ 用于窗口、侧边栏和菜单，Resources/ 位于 BrewUIComponents 和每个 BrewFeature* 包中。在 Xcode 中编辑目录。 关于以下步骤背后的理由，请参阅本地化部分。

paragraphs.en: The read-only Services tab shows installed formula services, their status, owner, login registration and service/log paths. Filter by All, Running or Stopped; start, stop and configure services in Terminal.
paragraphs.zh: 只读的「服务」标签页显示已安装的 formula 服务、它们的状态、所有者、登录注册以及服务/日志路径。 可按「全部」「运行中」或「已停止」筛选；请在终端中启动、停止和配置服务。
